faq.q: Net metering kitne din mein lag jati hai?
faq.a: LESCO aur DISCOs ke zariye green meter approval aam tor par 30 se 45 din mein mukammal ho jati hai. Hamari team complete documentation handle karti hai.

faq.q: 10kW solar system kitne units generate karta hai?
faq.a: 10kW system Lahore mein maahana aam tor par 1,200 se 1,400 units bijli paida karta hai, jis se monthly bill mein 70,000 se 90,000 rupay tak bachat hoti hai.

faq.q: Site survey ki fees kya hai?
faq.a: Lahore aur qareebi ilaqon mein technical site survey bilkul free hai.
